title: Enforcement Decree of the Leaf Tobacco Production Cooperatives Act
full_text:
Enforcement Decree of the Leaf Tobacco Production Cooperatives Act

Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Leaf Tobacco Production Cooperatives Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") and matters necessary for its enforcement.

Article 2 Deleted <December 26, 2002>

Article 3 Deleted <December 26, 2002>

Article 4 Deleted <December 26, 2002>

Article 5 (Inaugural General Meeting)
(1) Where promoters of a leaf tobacco production cooperative (hereinafter referred to as the "cooperative") intend to convene an inaugural general meeting pursuant to Article 11 of the Act, they shall notify persons qualified for membership under Article 15 (1) of the Act of the date, time, place, and matters to be submitted to the meeting at least two weeks before the meeting. <Amended on December 26, 2002; January 5, 2021>
(2) Resolutions of the inaugural general meeting shall require attendance of at least two-thirds of persons qualified for membership and the affirmative vote of a majority of those present.

Article 6 (Application for Authorization of Establishment) A person intending to obtain authorization for establishment of a cooperative pursuant to Article 11 of the Act shall submit an application for authorization to the Minister of Finance and Economy together with the following documents: <Amended on December 23, 1994; December 26, 2002; February 29, 2008; December 30, 2025>
1. Articles of association;
2. Minutes of the inaugural general meeting;
3. Business plan and budget of revenues and expenditures for the first business year;
4. List of officers;
5. Documents proving eligibility for membership and compliance with standards for authorization of establishment;
6. Minutes of the general meeting resolving on division or merger, or a register of votes of members (limited to establishment by division or merger, and stating the scope of rights and obligations to be succeeded to by the newly established cooperative).

Article 7 (Registration of Establishment and Commencement of Business)
(1) Where a cooperative completes registration of establishment under Article 13 (1) of the Act and commences its business, it shall without delay report to the Minister of Finance and Economy with a certified copy of the registration of establishment. <Amended on December 23, 1994; December 26, 2002; February 29, 2008; December 30, 2025>
(2) Where a person authorized to establish a cooperative fails to register its establishment within the registration period under Article 13 (1) of the Act, the Minister of Finance and Economy may revoke the authorization of establishment. <Amended on December 23, 1994; December 26, 2002; February 29, 2008; December 30, 2025>

Article 8 (Qualifications, etc. of Tobacco Cultivation Instructors) Tobacco cultivation instructors under Article 14 (2) of the Act shall be persons falling under any of the following:
1. A person who has passed the qualification examination for tobacco cultivation instructors conducted by the Korea Tobacco Growers Cooperative Association (hereinafter referred to as the "Central Association");
2. A person who, as an agricultural public official or rural extension public official, has at least two years of experience in tobacco cultivation guidance or rural extension affairs.

Article 9 (Loss of Membership) Grounds for loss of membership under Article 15 (4) of the Act shall be as follows: <Amended on December 26, 2002>
1. Where a tobacco cultivation contract has not been concluded with a tobacco manufacturer under the Tobacco Business Act or such contract has been terminated;
2. Where tobacco cultivation has been discontinued;
3. Where all tobacco cultivation has been transferred to another person;
4. Where the member ceases to reside within the district of the relevant cooperative.

Article 10 Deleted <December 30, 2016>

Article 11 (Grounds for Order of Dissolution) The Minister of Finance and Economy may order dissolution of a cooperative pursuant to Article 29 (1) 4 of the Act in any of the following cases: <Amended on December 23, 1994; December 26, 2002; February 29, 2008; December 30, 2025>
1. Where the cooperative violates statutes, its articles of association, or an order under Article 9 of the Act;
2. Where the cooperative fails to commence business within three months after completing registration of establishment;
3. Where management of the cooperative is so unsound that continued operation is significantly difficult or it is deemed impossible to achieve the purpose of establishment.

Article 12 (Application Mutatis Mutandis) Articles 5 through 7 and Article 11 shall apply mutatis mutandis to the Central Association.

Article 13 Deleted <March 3, 2020>

ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 12722, June 9, 1989>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Article 2 (Repeal of Other Statutes) The Regulation on Qualifications of Officers of Tobacco Production Cooperatives is hereby repealed.
Article 3 (Amendment of Other Statutes)
(1) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Korea Tobacco and Ginseng Corporation Act shall be amended as follows:
In Article 9 1, "tobacco production cooperatives and the federation thereof established under the Tobacco Production Cooperatives Act" shall be replaced with "tobacco production cooperatives and the Central Association thereof established under the Leaf Tobacco Production Cooperatives Act."
(2) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Tobacco Business Act shall be amended as follows:
In Article 3 (1) 2 and paragraph (2) of the same Article, "Federation of Tobacco Production Cooperatives" shall each be replaced with "Central Association of Leaf Tobacco Production Cooperatives."
Article 4 (Transitional Measures concerning Tobacco Cultivation Instructors) A tobacco cultivation instructor under the former provisions at the time this Decree enters into force shall be deemed a tobacco cultivation instructor under this Decree.
Article 5 (Transitional Measures concerning Prescribed Number of Personnel) Where, at the time this Decree enters into force, the actual number of personnel of a cooperative or the Central Association exceeds the prescribed number under its articles of association or other regulations, that actual number shall be deemed the prescribed number for the purposes of applying Article 2 (3) until the actual number and the prescribed number under the articles of association or other regulations of the cooperative or the Central Association coincide.

ADDENDUM (Organization of the Ministry of Finance and Economy and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 14438, December 23, 1994>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Articles 2 through 4 Omitted.
Article 5 (Amendment of Other Statutes) (1) through (37) Omitted.
(38) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Leaf Tobacco Production Cooperatives Act shall be amended as follows:
In Article 4 (1) and (2), Article 6, Article 7 (1) and (2), Articles 10 and 11, "Minister of Finance" shall each be replaced with "Minister of Finance and Economy."
(39) through (327) Omitted.

ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 17810, December 26, 2002>
(1) (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
(2) (Transitional Measures concerning Qualifications of Tobacco Cultivation Instructors) A person who, at the time this Decree enters into force, was an employee of Korea Tobacco and Ginseng Corporation under subparagraph 1 of Article 2 of the Act on the Improvement of Management Structure and Privatization of Public Enterprises and had at least two years of experience in tobacco cultivation guidance and was recognized as qualified as a tobacco cultivation instructor under former Article 8 (1) 2 shall, notwithstanding amended Article 8, be deemed qualified as a tobacco cultivation instructor.

ADDENDUM (Organization of the Ministry of Strategy and Finance and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 20720, February 29, 2008>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That among Presidential Decrees amended pursuant to Article 8 of these Addenda, the provisions amending Presidential Decrees promulgated before this Decree enters into force but not yet effective shall take effect on the respective effective dates of those Presidential Decrees.
Articles 2 through 7 Omitted.
Article 8 (Amendment of Other Statutes) (1) through (46) Omitted.
(47) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Leaf Tobacco Production Cooperatives Act shall be amended as follows:
In the portion other than the subparagraphs of Article 6, Article 7 (1) and (2), Articles 10, and the portion other than the subparagraphs of Article 11, "Minister of Finance and Economy" shall each be replaced with "Minister of Strategy and Finance."
(48) through (68) Omitted.

ADDENDUM (Partial Amendment Decree of the Enforcement Decree of the Housing Act, etc. for Establishing Regulatory Review Deadlines pursuant to Amendment of the Framework Act on Administrative Regulations) <Presidential Decree No. 25050, December 30, 2013>
This Decree shall enter into force on January 1, 2014. <Proviso omitted>

ADDENDUM (Partial Amendment Decree of the Enforcement Decree of the Building Act, etc. for Regulatory Reform including Establishment of Regulatory Review Deadlines) <Presidential Decree No. 25840, December 9, 2014>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on January 1, 2015.
Articles 2 through 16 Omitted.

ADDENDUM (Partial Amendment Decree of the Enforcement Decree of the Fair Transactions in Franchise Business Act, etc. for Establishing Regulatory Review Deadlines) <Presidential Decree No. 27751, December 30, 2016>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on January 1, 2017. <Proviso omitted>
Articles 2 through 12 Omitted.

ADDENDUM (Presidential Decree on Partial Amendment of 144 Presidential Decrees for Abolishing Regulatory Review Deadlines, etc.) <Presidential Decree No. 30509, March 3, 2020>
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDUM (Presidential Decree on Partial Amendment of 473 Statutes for Improving Difficult Legal Terminology) <Presidential Decree No. 31380, January 5, 2021>
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso omitted>

ADDENDUM (Organization of the Ministry of Finance and Economy) <Presidential Decree No. 35947, December 30, 2025>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on January 2, 2026: Provided, That among Presidential Decrees amended pursuant to Article 6 of these Addenda, the provisions amending Presidential Decrees promulgated before this Decree enters into force but not yet effective shall take effect on the respective effective dates of those Presidential Decrees.
Articles 2 through 5 Omitted.
Article 6 (Amendment of Other Statutes) (1) through (48) Omitted.
(49) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Leaf Tobacco Production Cooperatives Act shall be amended as follows:
In the portion other than the subparagraphs of Article 6, Article 7 (1) and (2), and the portion other than the subparagraphs of Article 11, "Minister of Strategy and Finance" shall each be replaced with "Minister of Finance and Economy."
(50) through (313) Omitted.
